name: Tea-Scented Tassel
desc:
Refinement material for "Silver Light."
A tassel carrying the fragrance of freshly picked tea leaves, with the spiritual power of the Wind Reader held deep within. When lightly brushed across the mithril blade, it seems to restore its keen edge.

value.text:
Version 7.1 Event: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
Event EXP Rewards: Festive Cheer

value.name: Silver Light
value.desc: A longsword left behind by Wind Reader, one of the Three Hermits of Guizang in Liyue. Legend has it that it was forged out of sacred silver descended from the heavens, and that it once cleaved flowing sea water into two.
